text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we've seen the same cache-eviction pattern 3x in the last quarter. We need a trimmed runbook checklist, concrete commands, and clear owners for remediation. Can we pick owners and deadlines here?

kevin: +1. I can own the runbook edits and the PR. Will propose a concise triage flow (3 steps) and a short command cheat-sheet.

sam: I can contribute the root-cause snippets and the delta in sequence-length distribution that seems to trigger the KV growth.

lisa: Product wants to be able to opt into a higher eviction threshold for dedicated customers — we'll need an explicit config & rollback step in the runbook.

akshay: oncall: when this happens during peak, our manual mitigation is painful. We should add an automated alert with a ‘suggested action’ link that runs an approved mitigation play.

maria: Proposed short triage flow (draft):
1) Confirm symptom: `redis-kv evictions > 50/min OR model-serving-kv misses spike`
2) Quick containment: toggle `kv_prefix_cache: read-only` for the offending model and scale up pool (if autoscale fails)
3) Restore / followup: roll to quantized fallback model if latency > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes
Add explicit commands and runbook links below.

kevin: Draft commands for step 2 (will add to runbook):
```
# mark cache read-only for model foo
redwoodctl models patch foo --set cache.read_only=true
# scale GPU pool
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-foo-pool --replicas +2
```
I'll put those in a PR: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pulls/342 (WIP).

maria: Great. For step 1 can we add the exact alert thresholds and the query? e.g., `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 50`

sam: Adding the query and a brief explainer about why sequence-length skew increases KV size. Will paste snippet into the PR.

akshay: Owner + timeline proposal: kevin -> runbook edits PR by EOD Friday (1707863400), maria -> verification & merge by Monday (1708036200), sam -> test scenarios + unit/test harness by next Wed (1708209000). If we need extra time we escalate.

lisa: LGTM, but product needs the rollback step explicitly — e.g., how to undo `cache.read_only` and where to record customer toggles. Add a step: notify #product-alerts with template.

incident-bot: New action created: `rb-342` assigned to kevin (due 1707863400) — runbook update for cache-eviction triage.

sre-oncall: Suggest automating a safe mitigation button (runs `redwoodctl models patch ...` behind a permission gate). Filing infra ticket for approval: INFRA-1187.

kevin: Added a short rollback snippet to the PR and a template for product notifications. PR now includes: triage steps, commands, alert queries, and a small decision tree. Link: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pull/342 (ready for review).

maria: Thanks. Final checklist before merge:
- [ ] kevin: address comments in PR (rb-342)
- [ ] sam: attach test scenarios (load with long-prefix distribution)
- [ ] maria: smoke test in staging and sign off
- [ ] akshay: add automation ticket and permission matrix
- [ ] lisa: confirm product notification template + rollback wording

kevin: I'll ping folks on Friday morning for a last pass. If anyone wants to be co-owner of a section, say so now.

sam: I'll co-own the test scenarios and post the harness instructions in the PR.

lisa: I'll add the product-notify snippet and the customer-facing rollback note.

maria: Perfect. We'll track rb-342 in the postmortem action tracker and close next-week sync if merged. Meeting to verify merged runbook: Monday 10am PT. :calendar:

akshay: Noted. I'll update the oncall runbook to reference the new page once merged.

kevin: Thanks everyone — will update PR and add a short TL;DR at the top for faster oncall scanning. :white_check_mark:

maria: Closing the thread — please update the action tracker when you complete your tasks. If anything slips, escalate here. :thumbsup:
